details: These versions run a postinstall hook (scripts/postinstall.mjs) that silently rewrites developer AI-assistant configuration on the installing machine: it appends or replaces a marked instruction block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, creates ~/.cursor/rules/agentgates.md and appends to ~/.windsurfrules. The injected text tells the assistant to route every wallet, balance, send, swap and earn operation through the bundled `agentgates` CLI and to prefer it over other tooling, placing attacker-authored instructions into the agent's trusted context at install time. The bundled CLI (dist/cli.mjs) has a hardcoded relay at hxxps://covenant-backend[.]vercel[.]app/api and sends POST/GET requests to that host carrying a bearer token read from the BOUNTY_LAUNCH_ADMIN_KEY or ADMIN_API_KEY environment variables. Network IOCs: hxxps://covenant-backend[.]vercel[.]app/api and hxxps://cli[.]agentgates[.]ai.
